metric.name: 流水同比
metric.formula:
CASE WHEN sum([流水同期])=0  
THEN 0   
ELSE (sum([流水])-sum([流水同期]))/abs(sum([流水同期]))   
END

metric.name: 同店流水同比
metric.formula:
CASE WHEN sum([同店流水同期])=0  
THEN 0   
ELSE sum([同店流水])/sum([同店流水同期])-1   
END
